subject: res-network-ports-and-listeners
text:
- **Network ports and listeners:** no network port — no TCP or UDP port; one local listener — the driver session's Unix-domain socket `{state_dir}/session.sock`, set to mode `0600` inside a state directory the caller names and `escher_driver::serve` creates `0700`, bound at the tree's one served listener site (beside it, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, one test-only bind: escher-driver's unix-only unit test `client::imp::tests::an_answer_read_past_its_bound_is_a_timeout` binds a `UnixListener` in `eab-{pid}` under the system temporary directory, accepts one connection and never answers, then removes the directory — no binary serves it and no caller reaches it, so it is no crossing, the operator's answer at that chunk's wrap, 2026-10-15; packages/escher-driver/src/client.rs:263-308), serving three requests at wire version `v3`, a call's replies including the fixed `recording-failed` — `hello`, `stop` and, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, `call` — so a call's element id and typed text cross in and an answer's ids, accessible names, control values (a password's or a file input's as the fixed mask), snapshot text and diff cross out, no `NodeId` among them, a request line at most 16,384 bytes and an answer at most 1,048,576; still no second listener; unix only — on other targets the lifecycle and a call return `SessionError::Unsupported` in 0.1.0 (packages/escher-driver/src/host.rs:109-124; packages/escher-driver/src/wire.rs:12) — a boundary widening, the founder's choice (the founder, 2026-10-07, relayed verbatim), as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-session/report.md, and widened again from lifecycle messages only to calls and their answers, ratified by the founder (2026-10-10, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label «Сокет несёт команды»;
 the English wording is the overseer's), as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/report.md. Since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface the `escher-session mcp` role (`escher_driver::serve_mcp`) speaks newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over its own stdin and stdout to the MCP client that spawned it, local to the invoking user — no listener, socket or port, so the session socket is still the one listener and there is still no network port; a tool call brings an element id and typed text in, and a result takes ids, accessible names, control values (a password's or a file input's as the fixed mask), snapshot text and diff out — a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-10, «Ратифицировать как есть», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label; the English wording is the overseer's), as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-mcp-surface/report.md. Since 2026-10-12-self-description the role also serves the `help` tool, answered by the server with no session run, and speaks a fourth handshake revision, `2025-11-25`, now its default; a result also carries the tool's self-description and a session error's remedy, and the tool listing each verb's result fields — the program's own fixed `'static` table text inside the ratified carrier, ratified by the founder (2026-10-12, «Внутри, с правилом», relayed verbatim by the overseer) — and a changed node's `differs`, closed node-key words; still no listener, socket or port, and the session socket unchanged (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-self-description/report.md).
 Since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot both carriers also take a shot of the screen out: the socket's answer to a `screenshot` call holds its PNG as base64 inside the JSON line, and the `mcp` role's result an `image` block (`image/png`, base64) then a text block — screen pixels in band, a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-12, «В самом ответе», relayed verbatim by the overseer) — still the one listener and no port, the wire's bounds unchanged, an MCP result that holds an image bounded by its whole written form (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md). Both carriers, and a kept check, also take a lint's findings out as the `lint` verb's answer — stable ids, the closed defect words and numbers, no `NodeId`, page text, colour or control value — a ratified boundary widening (§Established Decisions → [Driver session]); still the one listener and no port, the wire's bounds unchanged (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-19-visual-lint/report-gated.md).
 As adopted, before that chunk, observed absent — network ports or local hosts · searched: `localhost|port` over .github/workflows/*.yml, Cargo.toml, Cross.toml, flake.nix; a listening socket or local port · searched: `TcpListener|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1` over the 32 s03 files; any listening socket or port · searched: `TcpListener|bind\(|listen\(|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1` over the 86 s04 files; network listeners or fixed addresses · searched: `TcpListener|SocketAddr|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1` over the 15 s05 files; network listeners or ports · searched: `TcpListener|localhost|0\.0\.0\.0|\.bind` over the 17 s06 files; ports, sockets or listeners · searched: `port|bind\(|listen` over the 8 s07 files; any network port, socket bind or listener · searched: `fn main|\[\[bin\]\]|clap` over the 16 s08 files; network listeners or fixed host addresses · searched: `TcpListener|UdpSocket|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1` over the 32 s09 files; network listener or port binding · searched: `TcpListener|listen\(` over the 32 s10 files; any network port, host or socket binding · searched: `port|127\.0\.0\.1|localhost` over the 21 s11 files; network ports or listen addresses · searched: `localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|0\.0\.0\.0|bind\(` over the 61 s12 files; a network listener or socket · searched: `TcpListener|TcpStream|bind\(|listen\(` over the 12 s13 files

text:
- **Process-wide state and threads:** Stylo's global rayon pool under `StyleThreading::Parallel` (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:20-21; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:156-164); document ids from a static `AtomicUsize` starting at 1 (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:446-448); request ids from a static `AtomicUsize` (packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:88-90); a `thread_local!` `LAYOUT_CTX` per thread (packages/blitz-dom/src/resolve.rs:17-19); static `FONT_DB` under `svg` (packages/blitz-dom/src/util.rs:46-51); Android `OnceLock` `ANDROID_APP` (packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:69-85); thread `blitz-vibey-script-timers` (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/document.rs:353-356); log target `js_console` (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:36); in both binaries of the seven_guis package — `seven_guis_native` and the driver's command line and session host `escher-session`, its second install site (examples/seven_guis/src/session_host.rs:30) — `escher_telemetry::init` installs the global `tracing` default subscriber, the `log` → `tracing` bridge (`tracing_log::LogTracer`) and a chaining panic hook, records the first install in a static `OnceLock<ServiceIdentity>` behind a static `Mutex<()>` init lock, emits at log targets `escher_telemetry` and `escher_telemetry::panic`, and spawns no thread (examples/seven_guis/src/main.rs:6-9; packages/escher-telemetry/src/lib.rs:96-97; packages/escher-telemetry/src/lib.rs:144-161; packages/escher-telemetry/src/panic.rs:4-24); log target `escher_driver`, under which escher-driver's command span is emitted at INFO since 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans and its `tool_call` span since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface
 — admitted by the sink's `escher_` prefix and written only in a process that has a sink installed at `info` or below: the two re-run children of `stand_act_spans` and, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, an `escher-session` host, which runs each hosted call through `Session::run` under its installed sink — one closed-span line per call, 3 lines for 3 calls in `host_log` at `trace`, with 0 id needles, 0 name needles and 0 occurrences of a typed sentinel on the host's stderr under both builds, and since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface the `escher-session mcp` role — one `tool_call` line per tool call and a `command` line per instance call it runs through `Session::run`, 5 and 3 over one CRUD flow at `info`, with 0 id needles, 0 name needles and 0 occurrences of a typed sentinel at `trace` under both builds (`mcp_log`); `seven_guis_native` installs the sink and runs no command (packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:107; packages/escher-driver/src/mcp.rs:118-121; examples/seven_guis/tests/mcp_log.rs:53-315; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md, the host's lines at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/report.md); 64 event-handler count slots indexed by `DomEventKind` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:22-23; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:36); wasm32 browser `setTimeout` callbacks for resize settling (packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:530-547); WPT spawns `git rev-parse HEAD` in WPT_DIR and the current directory (wpt/runner/src/report.rs:11-24; wpt/runner/src/report.rs:31-32); `scripts/cold-agent.sh run` spawns one `claude` client (the Claude Code CLI) per run, which spawns `sh` → `escher-session mcp --record target/cold-agent/record` (`target/debug/escher-session`, `RUST_LOG=info` set on that child only, its stderr to `target/cold-agent/server.log`) connected over stdio only
 — since 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test, in place of `python3 cold_agent_stub.py`; the pipe's judge then spawns two `escher-session mcp` replay children directly, without `--record` (stderr to `/dev/null`), one for the full replay of the agent's check and one for the ablated replay, every reply bounded at 30 s (`REPLY_BOUND`), each killed and reaped — that replay crossing on the founder's «Один запуск, до $3 (Рекомендую)» and «JSON-проверка с повтором (Рекомендую)» (2026-10-15, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option labels; the English wording is the overseer's; confirmed at that chunk's wrap card, «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)»); the run ends them all, no listener, port or socket is added, and the client's own local messaging socket is the client's, opened by no escher code (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-06) (scripts/cold-agent.sh:580-584; scripts/cold-agent.sh:297-336; scripts/cold-agent.sh:339-356; scripts/cold-agent.sh:371-395; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-cold-agent-run-pipe/report.md and escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-15-cold-agent-test/report.md); five blitz-tests integration binaries re-execute their own test binary under `cargo test`, the first three once each and the fourth and fifth twice — since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot `stand_screenshot_repeat` runs `std::env::current_exe()` twice with a fixed argv, each child running its ignored `child_prints_its_shots` and printing its shots to stdout, which the parent captures and reads into its assertions only (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_screenshot_repeat.rs:75-98;
 tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_screenshot_repeat.rs:139-146), and `telemetry_stdout_silent` runs `std::env::current_exe()` with `--ignored --exact child_emits --nocapture`, its output captured and `RUST_LOG` removed from the child's env, `telemetry_drop` runs it with the same argv, its output captured and `RUST_LOG=warn,style=trace,dioxus_core=trace,selectors=trace` set on the child, which installs the sink with `init`, and `stand_id_persistence` runs it with `--ignored --exact ids_in_a_child_process --nocapture`, its output captured, setting or removing no env var, and `stand_act_spans` runs it with `--ignored --exact {child} --nocapture` on each of its two ignored children, its output captured, `RUST_LOG=info` set on one child and `RUST_LOG` removed from the other, each child installing the sink with `init_with_writer` over an in-memory capture — test-only, a fixed argv, no socket or port (tests/blitz-tests/tests/telemetry_stdout_silent.rs:10-14; tests/blitz-tests/tests/telemetry_drop.rs:14-22; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_id_persistence.rs:291-301; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_spans.rs:569-577; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-id-persistence/report.md, `telemetry_drop` at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist/report.md, `stand_act_spans` at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md); two more re-execute it as a session host — `stand_session_lifecycle` on each of its two ignored children, `--ignored --exact session_host --nocapture` serving under `IDLE_EXPIRY` and, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, `session_host_with_a_short_expiry` serving under a short expiry while the parent watches the state directory go, their streams sent to null, and `stand_session_quiet` with `--ignored --exact session_host_with_typed_text --nocapture`, its streams captured and `RUST_LOG=trace` set on the child
 — each child an `#[ignore]` test that serves one session on its Unix-domain socket in a state directory under `target/tmp/` until it is stopped or idle for its expiry, every wait of the parent bounded and a guard killing and reaping a host a failing check still holds; and eight seven_guis test targets spawn the built `escher-session` binary through `CARGO_BIN_EXE_escher-session` — `host_binary`, and `host_log` on `crud`, on `cells` (its paged part read: a sentinel committed into a part-2 cell, then `snapshot --part 2`; examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:137-280) and for a select's list opened and chosen through the host (examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:282-393) with `RUST_LOG=trace`, spawn the host role themselves, both streams piped and drained from the spawn on by one thread of the test process each, the session reached by `attach` polled under a 60 s bound, stopped by `stop` and its exit waited for under a 10 s bound; since 2026-10-10-driver-cli `host_timer` does the same on `timer`, `cli_commands` runs the binary once per command as a client, its sessions started by the binary's own `start` command, as `host_log`'s unix-only recording-clients check does too — `start crud --record` through `stop`, each run at `RUST_LOG=trace`, in `hl-client` and `hl-client-rec`, a `Started` guard stopping the session (examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:45-135) —
 and `cli_flow` runs the two flow scripts of `tests/flows/` under plain `sh`, each script running the binary once per step, and since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface `mcp_server` and `mcp_log` spawn its `mcp` role as a child spoken to over piped stdin, and `recording` does both, with `--record`, and runs `tests/flows/record_checks.sh` under `sh` into `rc-fresh`, both streams drained, a `Started` guard and the bounded run's 90 s, comparing both recorded files byte for byte with the committed copies — the eight sharing the helpers of `examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs`: the kill-and-reap guard, the stream drain, one bounded run of the binary as a client, a guard that stops a started session and, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, `Speaker`, which reads the child's stdout line by line on one thread under a 30 s reply bound and kills and reaps the child in its `Drop` (examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs:203-211; examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs:332-337; tests/blitz-tests/tests/session_common/mod.rs:344-408;
 tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_session_lifecycle.rs:239-255; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_session_quiet.rs:102-115; examples/seven_guis/tests/host_binary.rs:16; examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:27; examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:419-438; examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs:35-44; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-session/report.md, `host_log` at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist/report.md); the `escher-session` host itself is one process holding one session and one listener on its main thread, spawning no thread of its own — serving `load`, the stand's `LoadNet` spawns one per fetch (below) —, started by whoever runs it (`escher_driver::start` spawns the caller's `std::process::Command`) or, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, by the binary's own `start` command — which spawns the running binary again (`std::env::current_exe()`) as `serve <task> --session <dir>`, with `--record <dir>` after it when it was given one, with stdin, stdout and stderr closed, waits up to 30 s for the host to answer and drops the handle, neither killing nor reaping it — and ended by `stop` or by its idle expiry, 1,800 s with no answered request (examples/seven_guis/src/session_host.rs:8-58; packages/escher-driver/src/cli.rs:456-476); since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface the binary's `mcp` role is one process holding at most one session in process, with no listener and no thread of its own — under a `start load` the stand's `LoadNet` spawns one per fetch; its idle expiry checked when a request arrives — started by the MCP client that spawns it, its stderr the binary's `escher_telemetry::init` sink, a third role reaching that one install site (packages/escher-driver/src/mcp.rs:44-112; packages/escher-driver/src/mcp.rs:140-147)

subject: res-process-wide-state-and-threads
text: - `static PARALLEL_TRAVERSAL_LOCK: Mutex<()>` in blitz-dom's `stylo.rs`, process-wide: taken around every `StyleThreading::Parallel` traversal, so two documents resolving `Parallel` at once on Stylo's global rayon pool are serialised and no longer panic `already mutably borrowed` (blitz issue 430); its poison recovered by `unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())`, with no panic path and no log site; `Sequential` stays the default, and `Parallel` is set by the windowed `dioxus_native::launch` (`seven_guis_native`) and the browser's document loader and toolbar, by no headless document — harness, stand or driver (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:29-35; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:157-163; packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:63; packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:222; apps/browser/src/document_loader.rs:62; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:203).

subject: res-ci-infrastructure
text: - **CI infrastructure:** GitHub environments "Signed Builds" and "WPT" (.github/workflows/publish-browser.yml:41; .github/workflows/wpt.yml:106); WPT runner label `warp-ubuntu-latest-arm64-16x` with rust-cache provider "warpbuild" (.github/workflows/wpt.yml:27; .github/workflows/wpt.yml:32-38) — all reached only from `DioxusLabs/blitz`: every job that uses them (`release-cli`, `wpt`, `trigger-archive`, `post-results`) carries `github.repository == 'DioxusLabs/blitz'` in its `if`, so no fork ref reaches them (.github/workflows/publish-browser.yml:37; .github/workflows/wpt.yml:26; .github/workflows/wpt.yml:103; .github/workflows/wpt-post-results.yml:15); the fork's GitHub Actions cache (10 GB per-repository budget, least-recently-used eviction): the test job saves under `shared-key: workspace-test`, which the `a11y` job and, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, the `stand-repeat` job restore with `save-if: false`, and `audit` and `coverage` carry no cache step (.github/workflows/ci.yml:86-89; .github/workflows/ci.yml:256-259; .github/workflows/ci.yml:300-329); after the first run on a re-keyed lockfile it held 12 entries, 10 723 071 252 B — over the budget — with the `workspace-test` entry (1 006 409 498 B, restored once by `a11y`) and clippy's already evicted, while two pre-re-key matrix entries (≈ 2.16 GB) stood beside their re-keyed twins: a `Cargo.lock` change re-mints every key and evicts until the old keys age out — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-05-ci-gate-legs/evidence/ci-run.md (`gh cache list`, 2026-10-05, after CI run 37386253475)

It is not shown to be the cure of that job's out-of-disk failure (`Free space left: 5 MB`, CI#41190771843): the green runner had 86 GB free before the step, the failed run has no `df` line, and the red job alone among the `ubuntu-24.04` jobs stood on the older image `20261018.96.1`, whose free disk stays unread (.github/workflows/ci.yml:311-316; as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/evidence/ci.md)

subject: crosscut-config-management
text: - **Config management:** documents are configured through the `DocumentConfig` struct (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:29-72); optional capabilities are compile-time Cargo features, each dioxus-native feature forwarding to the same-named feature of the underlying blitz crates, and `accessibility` also to `dioxus-native-dom/accessibility`, which enables dioxus-native-dom's own optional `accesskit` and gates its `accessibility_tree` override and its `snapshot`, `snapshot_diff`, `snapshot_text` and `actionable` modules (packages/dioxus-native/Cargo.toml:16-33; packages/dioxus-native-dom/Cargo.toml:15-23; packages/dioxus-native-dom/Cargo.toml:41), with feature-gated code in the apps (apps/browser/src/main.rs:23-24; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:215-258; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:278-312); launch configs are `Box<dyn Any>` values downcast at launch (packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:115-146); platform behavior is gated with `cfg(target_os = ...)` and an `IS_MOBILE` const (apps/browser/src/main.rs:48; apps/browser/src/main.rs:79-89; apps/browser/src/tab_strip.rs:9-12); on `wasm32` system-font discovery is disabled and `build_single_font_ctx` is the standard WASM setup (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:463-466; packages/blitz-dom/src/lib.rs:135-140); runtime inputs are CLI arguments and environment variables (see Occupied Resources)

packages/dioxus-native/src/dioxus_application.rs:147-172) — and apps use `use_context_provider` / `use_context` (apps/browser/src/main.rs:121-123; apps/browser/src/tab.rs:211; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:46); packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/mod.rs:36-43); window event handlers live in a `SlotMap` applied per window id (packages/dioxus-native/src/event_handlers.rs:25-63; packages/dioxus-native/src/dioxus_application.rs:197-199)

subject: crosscut-event-processing
text: - **Event processing:** default-action events are queued and processed in order, each running handlers then its default action unless cancelled (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/driver.rs:352-359; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/driver.rs:423-426); events for sub-documents and custom widgets are forwarded with adjusted coordinates (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:18-27; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:125-180); focused text inputs are re-clamped to keep the caret visible (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:112-123; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:311-318); dioxus skips event kinds with zero handlers (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:346-352; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:349-359); `mounted` listeners fire after `initial_build` and each `poll` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:331-336; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:160-168; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:232-256); JS microtasks drained after eval, timers and event dispatch (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:127-145; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime/timers.rs:35; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime/events.rs:171-173); style and layout resolved before JS geometry, hit-test, selection and computed-style reads (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/element/geometry.rs:13-27; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/document.rs:326-331; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/style.rs:80-84); keyboard shortcuts use Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere (apps/browser/src/tab_strip.rs:42-56; apps/browser/src/util.rs:4-12)
